rules.name: Widget Organization Rule
rules.description: Widgets should be placed in a dedicated widget folder, with main logic in the main page files

required.description: Each feature should have a widgets folder for UI components

guidelines: All reusable UI components should be placed in the widgets folder
Main page files should only contain the page structure and business logic
Dialog widgets should be in the widgets folder, with their logic in the main page
Widget files should be named with PascalCase and end with 'Widget' (e.g., ProfileCardWidget.dart)
Each widget should be focused on a single responsibility
Complex widgets should be broken down into smaller components

incorrect.description: Widget defined in the main page file
